close_reason: Decision recorded in issue; no code change needed — these are preservation notes.
description: In chain_walk, check_name_constraints(cert, ...) is called BEFORE the NC state is updated from that cert's own NC extension. This is correct per RFC 5280 §6.1.4: a CA's NC constraints apply to its issued certificates, not to itself. If a contributor moves the NC update before the check (to 'apply constraints eagerly'), the CA's own names would be validated against its own constraints — which is wrong and would cause valid CA-signed paths to be rejected. The ordering is RFC-mandated.
title: NC state update AFTER check: applied to children, not self — do not reorder
